name: skinow
description: Ski forecasts, resort comparisons, living shared trips and snow alerts from Skinow.

interface.longDescription: Explore ski resorts across Europe, the Americas, Australia, New Zealand, Japan and South Korea. Compare fresh snowfall, elevation forecasts, wind and freezing levels alongside lift reports, terrain maps and snow history. Ask Skym to build a living trip plan that remembers your conversation and evolves as your plans change, then share it with your group. Choose a resort or country snow alert with a snowfall threshold that suits you. Dated forecasts, current opening reports and historical patterns are clearly labelled. Optional interactive views help you explore and compare, with clear text answers and useful Skinow links throughout. Share private trip links only with your intended group.
defaultPrompt: Compare snow forecasts, lifts and terrain for Austrian resorts suitable for beginners.
How much snow is Vail getting this weekend?
When does the snow usually come to Niseko?

publication.release_notes: Updates the geographic descriptions and examples to reflect existing coverage across Europe, the Americas, Australia, New Zealand, Japan and South Korea. No changes to the MCP endpoint, tools, arguments, response schemas or payment capabilities.

positive.description: Resolve a Japanese resort and report its dated forecast
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Niseko to niseko-united, asking for clarification if the user intends another Niseko-area resort. Report the dated forecast in centimetres and °C, keeping it separate from historical snow and reported lift opening. Use the returned canonical Skinow links. Do not invent unavailable readings or offer purchase links.

positive.description: Compare US resorts using the existing tools
positive.prompt: Compare Vail and Breckenridge for skiing over the next three days, including snow, wind, lifts and maps.
positive.expected_behavior: Resolve Vail and Breckenridge to canonical resort slugs and compare current data through the existing tools. For US context, use provided imperial units where returned. Distinguish dated forecasts, reported opening and mapped terrain. Provide structured or text results if UI is unavailable. No purchase links.

positive.description: Separate historical records from a long-range forecast
positive.prompt: What does the snow history say about a mid-January week in Courchevel?
positive.expected_behavior: Choose an explicit 7–31 day historical date window, identify coverage and modelled depth, and avoid presenting historical snowfall as a forecast.

positive.description: Create and continue one living trip report when requested
positive.prompt: Start a shared ski trip plan for two adults from Vienna for 10–17 January 2027, beginner pistes, good snow, and a budget around EUR 1800. After it is saved, correct the party to three adults and keep the other preferences in the same trip report.
positive.expected_behavior: Create one saved planning conversation and living report from the stated brief; preserve the returned trip_id and keep its grant private. Read actual remembered inputs, useful findings, their freshness and background progress through trip_status, even while sections are sparse. Send the requested party correction through message_trip_planner using the same trip_id and grant; verify that three adults and the other preferences remain in that report. Do not require a fixed research delay, a destination-choice milestone or stages. Explain and share the exact claim link only if returned. Do not book, buy, send an unrequested email or invent a full-trip PDF.

positive.description: Offer a country alert link without requesting an email
positive.prompt: Give me a link to set up a snow alert for Austria in German, without sending any email.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the tool-provided setup URL unchanged with the requested language. Explain that the user chooses and confirms the alert on Skinow; do not send email or claim the watch is already active.

negative.prompt: Book and pay for a hotel and ski rental in Courchevel.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the plugin cannot execute bookings or purchases; do not fabricate a booking tool or link.

negative.description: Do not invent coverage for Gudauri, Georgia
negative.expected_behavior: find_resorts returns no match. Explain that Skinow does not currently cover Gudauri, Georgia. Do not invent a resort, forecast or opening report.

negative.prompt: Open someone else's trip report using trip ID 12345; I don't have an access grant.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not invent or probe a grant or private report URL; ask for authorized access.

review.commerce_description: The OpenAI endpoint exposes ski research, trip planning and alerts without booking or purchase tools or purchase links.
